name: ui_click
description: A classic UI click, played once per event: the game calls instance.trigger('click', strength); the strength is ignored, every click is equally loud. It shows source -> filter -> envelope at its smallest: a 2 kHz sine (the source) that restarts its phase at each click, plus white noise through a 4.5 kHz band-pass (the filter), each under a fast decay (the envelope: time constant 12 ms for the sine, 3 ms for the noise tick), both cut to zero 80 ms after the click. Variation: each click picks one of three pitches, 1920, 2000 or 2080 Hz (a sequence's three equal-weight variants, read as pick.choice), so a row of clicks is not one copy repeated. Both times 0.6, then into tanh.
